Lessons12 lessons
1. Introduction and States of Mind▾

Recognize emotion mind, reasonable mind, and Wise Mind.

2. Observe▾

Notice present experience without immediately trying to change it.

3. Describe▾

Put words to observed facts, sensations, thoughts, and emotions without adding assumptions.

4. Participate▾

Enter fully into the activity of the present moment with awareness.

5. Non-Judgmentally▾

Notice and describe experience without turning evaluations into observed facts.

6. One-Mindfully▾

Do one thing at a time with attention in the present moment.

7. Effectively▾

Choose actions that work for the present situation and your goals.

8. Positive Self-Talk, Self-Compassion and Loving Kindness▾

Practise fair supportive self-talk, warmth, and caring responses to suffering.

9. Mindfulness of Emotions▾

Observe emotions as changing experiences without immediately acting on them.

10. Mindfulness of Thoughts▾

Notice thoughts as mental events rather than commands or facts.

11. Grounding▾

Reconnect with the present through sensory, body, orientation, and social practices.

12. Being Mind and Doing Mind▾

Balance goal-directed action with receptive awareness.
